import ast, json, pathlib
root = pathlib.Path(".")
files = sorted(root.rglob("*.py"))
for path in files:
    ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=path.as_posix())
conf_path = root / "djoser/conf.py"
conf_tree = ast.parse(conf_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=conf_path.as_posix())
assignment = next(node for node in conf_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "default_settings" for target in node.targets))
assert isinstance(assignment.value, ast.Dict)
defaults = {key.value: value for key, value in zip(assignment.value.keys, assignment.value.values) if isinstance(key, ast.Constant) and isinstance(key.value, str)}
assert ast.unparse(defaults["LOGIN_FIELD"]) == "User.USERNAME_FIELD"
serializers_call = defaults["SERIALIZERS"]
assert isinstance(serializers_call, ast.Call) and serializers_call.args and isinstance(serializers_call.args[0], ast.Dict)
serializer_defaults = {key.value: value.value for key, value in zip(serializers_call.args[0].keys, serializers_call.args[0].values) if isinstance(key, ast.Constant) and isinstance(key.value, str) and isinstance(value, ast.Constant)}
assert serializer_defaults["token_create"] == "djoser.serializers.TokenCreateSerializer"
serializer_path = root / "djoser/serializers.py"
serializer_tree = ast.parse(serializer_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=serializer_path.as_posix())
token_class = next(node for node in serializer_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == "TokenCreateSerializer")
expressions = {ast.unparse(node) for node in ast.walk(token_class)}
assert "self.fields[settings.LOGIN_FIELD]" in expressions
authenticate_calls = [node for node in ast.walk(token_class) if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "authenticate"]
assert any(any(keyword.arg == "username" and ast.unparse(keyword.value) == "attrs.get(settings.LOGIN_FIELD)" for keyword in call.keywords) for call in authenticate_calls)
settings_text = (root / "docs/source/settings.rst").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert "LOGIN_FIELD\n-----------" in settings_text
assert "User.USERNAME_FIELD" in settings_text
print(json.dumps({"configured_token_create_serializer": serializer_defaults["token_create"], "login_field_default": ast.unparse(defaults["LOGIN_FIELD"]), "login_field_documented": True, "python_files_parsed": len(files), "token_create_login_field_input": True, "token_create_login_field_authentication": True}, sort_keys=True))
